shared_elements: row of short repeated parallel strokes (comb/hatched band)
figures distributed in stacked registers over a broadly vertical surface
linear low-relief outline figures with little internal detail
justification: Both surfaces carry outlined, largely schematic profile creatures with long curving bodies distributed in loose superposed registers, and both include a band of repeated short parallel strokes forming a comb-like row, which is the most specific correspondence. However A shows a clearly organised programme (a row of frontal animal heads over a hatched band over identifiable quadrupeds, a bird with long neck and a small anthropomorphic figure), whereas B's figures are indistinct, scattered and lack any comparable head-row or figure-to-figure relationships, so the shared traits remain at the generic level.
